name: Leeuwin Metals Ltd
summary: Leeuwin Metals Ltd, a Subiaco company established in 2021, identifies, explores and develops nickel and lithium deposits. It fully owns ventures in Canada and Australia, among them a nickel project at William Lake in Manitoba (55 contiguous claims, 96.2 km2), the Jenpeg lithium project in Manitoba, and a lithium project at Ignace in Ontario.
